title: fleetd default state-dir disagrees with the daemon's socket derivation
wanted_capability: One shared code-owned derivation of the fleetd socket/token paths used by both the daemon client (which derives from its BRO dispatch store dir, state_dir/bro) and the fleetd binary's --state-dir default (which resolves the plain XDG state dir). Today only the daemon auto-start passes the correct explicit --state-dir; a launchd/systemd unit relying on fleetd's built-in default binds a socket the daemon never dials.
fallback_used: First prod rollout 2026-07-19: launchd unit with the plain state dir orphaned its fleetd while the daemon auto-started a second one at the derived path. Fixed operationally by pointing the unit's --state-dir at .../blackbox/bro; deploy/fleetd.plist and fleetd-dev.plist corrected with a comment explaining the derivation.
evidence: daemon log: 'harness executor: fleetd' socket=.../blackbox/bro/fleetd.sock vs unit --state-dir .../blackbox
